skills.name: Logic
levels: Spot the pattern in a short chain of clues.
Follow two conditions at once without mixing them up.
Rule out options that break a given constraint.
Build a short chain of if this then that reasoning.
Hold three or more conditions in mind and still find the answer.

skills.name: Proof
levels: Explain why an answer works using one clear reason.
Check an answer against the original question.
Show why a guess and check approach would still work.
Explain why an answer must be true, not just likely.
Write a short proof that another kid could follow and trust.

skills.name: Fractions
levels: Read a simple fraction like one half or one quarter.
Turn a simple fraction into a decimal.
Compare two fractions to see which is larger.
Add or subtract fractions with the same bottom number.
Add or subtract fractions with different bottom numbers.

skills.name: Patterns
levels: Notice when the same two things repeat in a row.
Point to what should come next in a simple repeat.
Copy a pattern someone else made.
Make a new pattern with two repeating parts.
Make a pattern with three repeating parts and explain it.
